---

### Summary of Benchmark Findings

1. **Per-Competitor Canonical Tutorial Flows**:
   * **Next.js (App Router / Acme Dashboard)**: 16-chapter course starting with CSS/fonts/images, layouts (`layout.tsx`), RSC data fetching (Ch 7), dynamic streaming, and Server Actions (Ch 11). First-win is immediate styled layout HMR (`npm run dev`).
   * **Nuxt (Nuxt 3/4 Getting Started)**: Topic-based guide featuring `npx nuxi init` welcome page first-win, highlighting auto-imports and hybrid rendering early, with composable API links (`useFetch`, `useState`).
   * **SvelteKit (Interactive Tutorial & Kit Docs)**: In-browser interactive playground (`learn.svelte.dev`) first-win, front-loading server data loaders (`+page.server.js` `load()`), form actions (`actions`), and auto-generated `$types`.
   * **Laravel Bootcamp & Rails Guides**: Real app build (Chirper / Blog) with instant welcome screen (< 3 mins), highlighting artisan/generator tooling, Eloquent/ActiveRecord ORM models, auth starter kits, and DB migrations early.

2. **Gap Analysis A — Undersold NetScript Capabilities**:
   * **Fresh Page Loaders & Composition (`definePage`, `QueryIsland`, `withResource`)**: Currently deferred until Track 4 ([`live-dashboard/04`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/live-dashboard/04-definePage-QueryIsland.md)) or obscured in Track 1 ([`storefront/06`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/storefront/06-storefront-ui.md)). Fix belongs in [`quickstart.vto`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/quickstart.vto#L146-L170), [`storefront/06`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/storefront/06-storefront-ui.md#L1-L60), and [`live-dashboard/04`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/live-dashboard/04-definePage-QueryIsland.md).
   * **Form Story & Server Mutations**: Bound route/form builder subpaths are obscured by raw client fetching. Fix belongs in [`storefront/03`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/storefront/03-cart-contracts.md) and [`storefront/06`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/storefront/06-storefront-ui.md).
   * **Contract-Derived SDK Autocomplete**: Delayed until Track 4 ([`live-dashboard/03`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/live-dashboard/03-sdk-cache-first-query.md)). Fix belongs in [`storefront/03`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/storefront/03-cart-contracts.md#L45-L65).
   * **Authorization Seam (`.withAuthz()`)**: Sequestered in Track 2 ([`workspace/05`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/workspace/05-route-authz.md)). Fix belongs in [`storefront/04`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/storefront/04-checkout-saga.md) and [`workspace/05`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/workspace/05-route-authz.md).

3. **Gap Analysis B — NetScript Differentiators with No Peer Equivalent**:
   * **Contract-Derived End-to-End Typing (OpenAPI + SDK + Handlers)**: Peers require manual third-party wiring (tRPC, Orval, Zod). NetScript auto-derives all three from shared contracts. (Treated loudly in [`quickstart.vto`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/quickstart.vto) & [`storefront/02`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/storefront/02-catalog-service.md)).
   * **Native Durable Sagas & Workers in Workspace**: Peers lack native durable execution (requiring Temporal/Inngest). NetScript runs stateful sagas natively. (Treated loudly in [`storefront/04`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/storefront/04-checkout-saga.md) & [`erp-sync/02`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/erp-sync/02-import-job.md)).
   * **Aspire Observed Resource Graph**: Peers leave infrastructure & OpenTelemetry orchestration to third parties. NetScript boots Postgres, Redis, and tracing automatically via `aspire start`. (Treated loudly in [`quickstart.vto`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/quickstart.vto) & deploy chapters).
   * **`withResource` Cross-Layer Dedup**: Peers use basic `cache()` or layout passing. NetScript deduplicates & refines types across layouts, partials, and islands. (Featured in #1210 Web Layer sub-pages & [`live-dashboard/04`](file:///home/codex/repos/ns-docs-orch/docs/site/tutorials/live-dashboard/04-definePage-QueryIsland.md)).
   * **Built-in Partials & Deferred Loaders**: High visibility alternative to heavy JS bundle streaming.

4. **Prioritized Recommendations for #1210 Sub-Pages**:
   * **P0**: `@netscript/fresh/builders` (`definePage`), `withResource` dedup/refinement subpath, and `QueryIsland` SDK hydration subpath.
   * **P1**: Partials & `defer` subpath, and `route`/`query`/`form` bound contract subpaths.
   * **P2**: Cross-layer monorepo workflow integration (Contracts → Web → Sagas/Workers).
